answer: One small dispatcher can own shared provenance/ROM/contract gates and counters; eight typed adapters retain their distinct ABIs. Deterministic gameplay equivalence is NOT YET DEMONSTRATED because no native island was activated or replay-compared.

4 canonical-ROM hook cases matched in Debug and Release; six accepted direct callers
helpers.NATIVE_ADAPTER: initialize_raw_record_fields(bounded record span, D0.low) -> stage five field writes

helpers.REPLAY_EVIDENCE: 4 full-register/CCR and memory cases matched in Debug and Release; Linux native test passed
helpers.NATIVE_ADAPTER: store_sparse_raw_words(bounded writable span, base offset, D0.low, incoming D1/SR) -> stage four words, A0/D1/SR

helpers.REPLAY_EVIDENCE: 15 natural calls matched; count 0/1/2; synthetic coordinate-cull and D2-limit branches and ordered SAT writes covered
helpers.NATIVE_ADAPTER: build_sat_shadow_records(bounded count+record input, explicit SAT capacity, D2/A1 state) -> staged ordered shadow words

helpers.NATIVE_ADAPTER: ByteGridView::sample_world(typed view, proven coordinates) -> stage D5 result

dispatch_decision_flow: observe helper entry after exact transfer event
check canonical ROM SHA and helper entry PC
check exact transfer source PC and accepted transfer kind
check helper-specific enable flag and path-specific verification status
check contract ID/version and evidence receipt identity
decode inputs through helper typed adapter without mutation
validate complete bounded effect plan and memory windows
commit atomically and return through a core-validated return boundary; otherwise leave state untouched and execute original ROM

registry_shape.one_master_switch: optional off-by-default only; never overrides per-helper false

abi_adapter_rule: Use common immutable CPU/memory snapshot only as adapter input. Each adapter calls its typed model and emits a helper-specific staged effect plan; do not expose a universal mutable D/A register array to game code.

rom_fallback.before_mutation: Any failed gate or invalid input returns DECLINE at the untouched helper entry so original ROM executes.
rom_fallback.commit: Validate every effect before mutation; commit atomically. If rollback cannot be guaranteed after a commit failure, stop the development run instead of continuing from partial state.
rom_fallback.cpu_return: Use a core-provided, tested return/continuation primitive. Do not directly patch PC/A7 until prefetch/interrupt semantics are validated.

reference_mode.preferred: paired deterministic replay: one ROM-only baseline and one shadow/native prediction or enabled replay, compare at helper return and frame landmarks
reference_mode.comparison: only contract-listed registers, CCR bits, bounded memory writes, stack/cursor effects and continuation state
reference_mode.mismatch: log helper/caller/contract/pre/post; disable helper; preserve ROM authority. If mismatch follows active mutation, restore a complete checkpoint or abort.

failure_policy.rom_hash_mismatch: disable all native gates; original ROM
failure_policy.contract_or_receipt_mismatch: disable affected helper and ROM fallback
failure_policy.invalid_adapter_input: decline before mutation and ROM fallback
failure_policy.native_exception: catch before commit and ROM fallback; abort if state may be partially mutated
failure_policy.differential_mismatch: record, disable route; ROM remains reference; do not promote verification

baseline_all_disabled.rom_helper_calls: exact measured baseline count for all eight targets

each_helper_enabled_independently.native_helper_calls: exact count of accepted caller/transfer hits for that entry
each_helper_enabled_independently.rom_helper_calls: baseline count minus accepted native calls; all unsupported callers still ROM
each_helper_enabled_independently.fallback_count: equal to enabled-target gate declines, grouped by reason

all_eight_enabled.native_helper_calls: sum of independently accepted path hits
replay_invariants: no new execution paths outside helper return boundaries

risks: All proof is path-specific; indirect and unlisted direct callers stay ROM-only.
Functional equivalence does not prove cycle, prefetch, bus-write timing or interrupt-boundary equivalence.
Some helper adapters have bounded memory outputs and require preflight/atomic effect commit.
9C40 and 9DB4 caller provenance relies on exact transfer-source metadata; stale provenance must be invalidated across exceptions/interrupts.
Whole-session deterministic replay equivalence has not yet been run with these eight routes enabled.
recommendation: Keep all eight disabled and implement no production dispatch in this task. The static registry/adapter boundary is justified; first validate the CPU return primitive and run the all-disabled baseline plus one helper at a time in deterministic replay before considering any activation.
